notes.title: Patch Notes for May 21
notes.notes:
- Changes:

1. Added death count to the in-game options screen (this is not visible from the options accessed from the title screen).
2. Added additional guide images to Stage 11.
3.Reversed the interaction effect for lighting fires (fires now light up when interacted with).

 - Bug Fixes:

1.Fixed a bug where the character sprite would disappear after landing from a jump in Stage 11.
2. Fixed an issue where entering and exiting the first stage before hitting the save point would return the player to the first save point.
3. Expanded the range of the teleport gimmick in mid-air in Stage 12.
4. Fixed a bug where objects requiring interaction would not reset or interact correctly upon stage reset.
5. Fixed an issue where new save points were not properly saved during stage resets.

notes.title: May 18th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Following errors and optimizations in progress.

1. Adjusted wall collision detection.
2. Fixed a bug where falling speed persisted after taking damage while diving and restarting from a save point.
3. Fixed a bug where consecutive damage above a certain threshold did not revert to a save point.
4. Partially adjusted character's jumping ability.
5. Optimized water objects.

notes.title: Update_May 15th Patch 2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the 'Warp to Another Save Point' feature was not working properly.
- Added the ability to save background and sound effect volume settings.

notes.title: Update: May 15 Patch
notes.notes: Bug fix: Resolved an issue where the save point locations were incorrect or not visible when using the 'Warp to Another Save Point' feature.

notes.title: Update_ May 14 Patch 2
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

- Steam achievement completion error
- Partial modification of decorations in stage 12
- Fixed item regeneration error in the field reset function

notes.title: Update_The bug patch on May 14
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where players could not progress to the next stage from the final finish portal in Stage 1.
